summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release announcing final positive results and analysis from its grade control drilling program at the Fenn-Gib Project. The program tested ~1.0M tonnes of probable mineral reserves from the 2025 pre-feasibility study, focusing on a 60x70 meter area with 56 diamond drill holes to 75 meters depth. Results showed that at a 0.8 g/t Au cut-off, the grade control model returned similar grade with 2% more tonnes; above 3.0 g/t Au, 28% more tonnes at 7% higher grade. CEO Drew Anwyll stated the program de-risks early high-grade feed and supports project financing discussions. This is an operational update, not a special situation.
